title: feat(ui): a dashboard render sends its dataset queries as one batch request
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBU2LQTFSLMm7QhD7vdTWs9b)_

Fixes #32165

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：仪表盘一次渲染里各个数据集组件的查询，改为按包合并成一个 `POST /analytics/dataset/query/batch` 请求发出（适配器新增 `queryDatasetBatch`，仪表盘内加一个按渲染收集查询的合并层），不再每个组件各发一个请求。
- 为什么改：Chart Gallery 打开时发 18 个请求、Delivery Operations 发 9 个，首屏随组件数变慢；服务端批量接口已由 #32322 落地，这是控制台这一半。
- 风险与回滚：每个组件仍拿到自己的结果或自己的拒绝（拒绝走与单个请求同一套分类，界面一致），一个查询被拒不影响其他组件；服务端没有批量接口（404）时自动退回逐个请求；只改 `data-objectstack` 与 `plugin-dashboard`，回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts` 的 `sendDatasetQueryBatch` 与 `batchEntryRefusalBody`（逐条拒绝如何还原成单个请求的错误），以及 `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/datasetQueryBatch.ts` 的合并窗口。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/datasetQueryBatch.test.ts packages/data-objectstack/src/queryDataset.test.ts`，预期 3 个文件 74 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`@object-ui/data-objectstack`: `ObjectStackAdapter.queryDatasetBatch(queries, { packageId?, previewDrafts? })`.** It runs several dataset queries over `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query/batch` and resolves to one outcome per query, in order, in `Promise.allSettled`'s shape. Each outcome is what `queryDataset` gives that query alone. It never rejects itself.

- **One ladder for every refusal.** The single door's refusal classification moved, unchanged, out of `queryDataset` into `datasetQueryRefusal`. The single door's non-2xx answer, a batch entry's `{ status, error }` and a whole-batch refusal all go through it, so a refused query reaches its widget as the same error class with the same message (`AnalyticsDatasetNotFoundError`, `AnalyticsForbiddenError`, `AnalyticsNotInstalledError`, `AnalyticsUnauthenticatedError`, or the generic `Dataset query failed: …`). The 200-body reading moved the same way into `datasetQueryAnswer`, which a batch entry's `{ data }` also goes through.
- **A batch entry's code, read back.** The batch door maps a refusal into the house envelope (`DatasetQueryBatchEntrySchema`): a 4xx code outside the vocabulary moves to `declaredCode`, and `code` takes the status's member. So below 500 the door's own code is `declaredCode ?? code`. At 5xx the door wrote both itself, and its code is `code` (`batchEntryRefusalBody`). Without this, a 403 whose producer code is outside the vocabulary would read as `PERMISSION_DENIED` in a batch and as the generic error alone. The ablation below shows the pin catching that.
- **What one request carries, measured on the route.** The batch URL's `?package=` and `?preview=` are read once for every query (`refuseRepeatedQueryParams(req, res, ['preview', 'package'])` in `analytics-routes.ts`), and `?package=` is read only for a `datasetName` (`metaItemPackageBinding(req.query?.package)` in the saved-name branch). So queries are grouped by the package the single door would send them with: a saved name with the caller's package, an inline draft with none. Each group goes in requests of at most `DATASET_QUERY_BATCH_MAX_QUERIES` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/api`), sent side by side. A request that would carry one query is the single door's own request.
- **A batch refused whole.** If the refusal is no query's own (`401`, `501 NOT_IMPLEMENTED`, a `400` shape refusal), every query of that request gets the single door's error for that answer, and no fallback request is sent. A server that does not serve the batch door (`404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`, or a bare 404/501 no ObjectStack route wrote, `batchDoorAbsent`) has each query answered by the single door, and the adapter stops asking that server for batches. An answer without one result per query refuses every query with a sentence that says so. A request that fails in transit refuses every query with that failure.

**`@object-ui/plugin-dashboard`: a render-scoped coalescer.** `createDatasetQueryCoalescer` (in the new `datasetQueryBatch.ts`) collects the `queryDataset` calls made before the current task ends, which is one microtask window. Every widget effect of one commit runs inside that window. It groups them by `packageId` and `previewDrafts` and hands each group to the source's `queryDatasetBatch`.

- `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` create one per resolved data source (`useDatasetQueryCoalescer`) and provide it through `DatasetQueryCoalescerContext`.
- `DatasetWidget` and the filter bar's `optionsFrom` read ask it only when it batches for the same source they hold. Otherwise they ask the source as before. Each caller keeps its own effect, promise, error state and invalidation refetch.
- A query alone in its group takes `queryDataset` with the caller's own arguments, byte-for-byte. A source without `queryDatasetBatch` (a hand-written adapter, the Studio canvas wrapper) gets `queryDataset` for every query, unchanged.
- **Invalidation refetch:** a refetch uses the single door when it is alone in its window, which is what I chose. A write that several widgets read re-reads them together in one batch.

Docs: `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` and `content/docs/frontend/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` each gain a short section, "Dataset widgets share one request per render".

## Why

#32165 item 1: one `POST /analytics/dataset/query` per widget, 9 on Delivery Operations and 18 on Chart Gallery. The server half is #32200 (PR #32322, `eefda1ad`). Item 2 landed as PR #32227. The comment that recorded it (6770834941) puts tall cards (example metadata) and the System Overview skeletons (app-shell boot) outside this card, so this is the last open item and the PR says `Fixes`.

## Verification

At head `5fce3b2e`:

- **Live count, prod console build.** `turbo run build` built `ui/apps/console`; `vite preview` served it (no StrictMode double effects) against a `pnpm dev -- --fresh` showcase boot; Playwright signed in as admin and counted `POST …/analytics/dataset/query*`:

| Dashboard | Leg | Requests | Shape |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| Chart Gallery | this branch | 1 | `…/dataset/query/batch?package=com.example.showcase`, 18 queries |
| Chart Gallery | CONTROL, batch route answered `404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` in the browser | 19 | the refused batch, then 18 single `…/dataset/query?package=com.example.showcase` (the per-widget pattern of `main`, through the fallback) |
| Delivery Operations | this branch | 1 | one batch, 9 queries |

  Every widget painted on each leg: no `dataset-loading` left and no alert.
- **Pins.**
  - `DashboardRenderer.datasetBatch-32165.test.tsx` (7 tests):
    - One render asks the batch door once, with all 4 widget queries in render order, and never the single door. CONTROL: a source with no batch door is asked 4 times.
    - The dashboard's served package goes with the batch.
    - `DashboardGridLayout` batches too.
    - A refused query draws, in its widget, the same alert markup (`outerHTML` equal) as the single door's refusal of it, and its siblings render.
    - A write to one object re-reads only its widget, through the single door. A write several widgets read re-reads them in one batch.
  - `datasetQueryBatch.test.ts` (5 tests): the window, grouping, single-door passthrough, and a throwing batch door.
  - `queryDataset.test.ts` (18 new tests, 62 in the file):
    - The batch body, in order, with each `{ data }` read as the single door reads its body.
    - A lone query takes the single door.
    - The package split, with inline drafts going without a package. Preview intent is carried.
    - `2 × max + 2` queries split into `[50, 50, 2]`.
    - Six refusal parity cases, each against the single door's own error for the same refusal: class, message and `code`.
    - Route absent falls back and is remembered; a bare 404 falls back too.
    - Whole-batch `501` and `401`, a short answer, and a transit failure.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored to `HEAD`, blob verified):
  - `batchEntryRefusalBody` reading `e.code` only: the demoted-4xx parity pin fails (1 failed, 61 skipped).
  - `DatasetWidget` bypassing the coalescer: 6 of the 7 dashboard pins fail, and the CONTROL passes.
- **Suites** (before the `main` merge, whose 29 files touch no `ui/`, spec or analytics path): `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/ packages/data-objectstack/` gave 324 files and 3359 tests passed (6 skipped). That covers the named invalidation pins `DatasetWidget.invalidationRefetch-10815`, `DatasetWidget.kpiInvalidation-11095` and `DashboardRenderer.ambientSource-10815`.
- **Type-check:** `pnpm run type-check` in both packages (plugin-dashboard runs src and `tsconfig.test.json`) is green.
- **Lint:** `npx eslint` on every changed file gives 0 errors. `pnpm check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new citations.
- **Derived gates:** `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciled on this head: 70 derived, 70 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every one exit 0 (run at `2dfeda23`; the two commits after it retype and rename inside `datasetQueryBatch.ts`, and its type-check, tests and the scripts suite were re-run on them). The first pass caught one: `one-authority-per-exported-name-6273` (in `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`) found `DatasetBatchOutcome` exported by both packages, so the coalescer's type is now `DatasetQueryOutcome`; that suite then gave 171 files passed (2 skipped).

No translation key was added.

## Acceptance notes

- A batch entry carries no HTTP reason phrase, so a generic refusal's sentence reads `Dataset query failed: 400 — …` where the single door over HTTP/1.1 reads `400 Bad Request — …`. Over HTTP/2 the single door has no phrase either. The class, `code` and server message are the same.
- A code-less 5xx entry arrives with the status's derived code, so a code-less `501` reads as `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` (still "not installed", the same branch the single door's bare-501 residual takes).
- The Studio canvas wraps the data source (`canvasDataSource.ts`) without `queryDatasetBatch`, so a dashboard previewed on the canvas still sends one request per widget. Forwarding the batch door there is a separate change.
- Other `queryDataset` callers (`ObjectChart`, `DatasetReportRenderer`, `DatasetPreview`) are not a dashboard render and are unchanged.
